mapper.select: select user_id, profile_status, profile_data, calculate_time, create_time, update_time from t_user_profile where user_id = #{userId}
select id from t_wxuser order by id

select distinct changed.user_id from ( select u.id as user_id from t_wxuser u left join t_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.id where p.user_id is null
union all
select e.user_id from t_user_behavior_event e inner join t_wxuser u on u.id = e.user_id left join t_user_profile p on p.user_id = e.user_id where e.event_time >= timestampadd( MINUTE, -10, coalesce(p.calculate_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'))
union all
select o.user_id from t_order o inner join t_wxuser u on u.id = o.user_id left join t_user_profile p on p.user_id = o.user_id where greatest( coalesce(o.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.update_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.pay_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.ship_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.finish_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.cancel_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.refund_apply_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), coalesce(o.refund_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ) >= timestampadd( MINUTE, -10, coalesce(p.calculate_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'))
union all
select o.user_id from t_scan_order o inner join t_wxuser u on u.id = o.user_id left join t_user_profile p on p.user_id = o.user_id where coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') >= timestampadd( MINUTE, -10, coalesce(p.calculate_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) ) changed order by changed.user_id

select e.scene, e.event_type as evidence_type, e.product_id, case when e.scene = 'MALL' then mp.product_name else sp.product_name end as product_name, case when e.scene = 'MALL' then coalesce(e.category_id, mp.category_id) else coalesce(e.category_id, sp.category_id) end as category_id, case when e.scene = 'MALL' then mc.category_name else sc.category_name end as category_name, case when e.scene = 'MALL' then mp.price else sp.price end as price, sp.product_type, mp.origin, mp.processing_method, mp.roast_level, mp.flavor_notes, e.spec_json, e.event_time as evidence_time from t_user_behavior_event e left join t_product mp on e.scene = 'MALL' and mp.product_id = e.product_id left join t_category mc on mc.category_id = coalesce(e.category_id, mp.category_id) left join t_scan_product sp on e.scene = 'SCAN' and sp.product_id = e.product_id left join t_scan_category sc on sc.category_id = coalesce(e.category_id, sp.category_id) where e.user_id = #{userId} and e.event_type in ('PRODUCT_VIEW', 'CART_ADD') order by e.event_time desc, e.event_id desc

select purchase.scene, purchase.evidence_type, purchase.product_id, purchase.product_name, purchase.category_id, purchase.category_name, purchase.price, purchase.product_type, purchase.origin, purchase.processing_method, purchase.roast_level, purchase.flavor_notes, purchase.spec_json, purchase.evidence_time from ( select 'MALL' as scene, 'PURCHASE' as evidence_type, i.product_id, i.product_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, i.price, null as product_type, p.origin, p.processing_method, p.roast_level, p.flavor_notes, null as spec_json, coalesce(o.pay_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time) as evidence_time from t_order o inner join t_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join t_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id left join t_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status in (1, 2, 3) and coalesce(o.refund_status, 0) <> 2 and (i.spec is null or i.spec not like '赠品%')
union all
select 'SCAN' as scene, 'PURCHASE' as evidence_type, i.product_id, i.product_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, i.price, p.product_type, null as origin, null as processing_method, null as roast_level, null as flavor_notes, i.spec_json, coalesce(o.pay_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time) as evidence_time from t_scan_order o inner join t_scan_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join t_scan_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id left join t_scan_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and coalesce(o.refund_status, 0) <> 2 ) purchase order by purchase.evidence_time desc, purchase.product_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_user_profile ( user_id, profile_status, profile_data, calculate_time, create_time, update_time ) select #{userId}, #{profileStatus}, #{profileData}, #{calculateTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} from t_wxuser where id = #{userId} on duplicate key update profile_status = values(profile_status), profile_data = values(profile_data), calculate_time = values(calculate_time), update_time = values(update_time)
